name: test-proxy-recorder
description: test-proxy-recorder is an open-source npm package that records real HTTP and WebSocket traffic during Playwright test runs and replays it deterministically on CI, with no backend running and no hand-written mocks. It covers server-side rendering traffic through an HTTP proxy and browser traffic through Playwright's HAR routing, and integrates with Next.js and TanStack Start. Requires Node.js 20 or later and @playwright/test 1.0.0 or later. MIT licensed, maintained by Aleksandr Smyshliaev.
